idea: Paid briefing on AI adoption in financial services
buyer: COOs, heads of research, innovation leads at funds and banks
pain: Vendor noise drowns out what firms are actually doing
v1: A fortnightly briefing on real deployments
verdict: Good fit and leverage, but a briefing needs an audience she has to build from nothing.

why.distribution: Some warm readers, but a paid briefing needs hundreds of subscribers and she has no list.
why.demand: Inferred; free AI newsletters are abundant and good.
why.fmf: She has run adoption inside a firm, so she can report what actually happens rather than what vendors claim.
why.defensibility: Access to practitioners willing to talk candidly would compound.
why.ceiling: £150/mo x 110 seats = £198k, needing an audience of thousands from zero.

ceiling_arithmetic: £150/mo x 110 seats = £198k. At a 4% free-to-paid conversion that implies ~2,700 free subscribers within a year from no list. Realistic: 25-40 paid = £45-72k.
carries: Genuine insider authority on a topic with real budget, and full media leverage.
kills: Distribution from zero. The founder profile flags that audience-first businesses cost 6-12 months before revenue.
test: Publish four issues free and count how many practitioners ask to be interviewed or forward it.
test_pass: Unprompted requests to subscribe or pay.
